import os
workspace=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace')
programs=workspace/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    marks = [v for v in counts if v != background]
    mark = min(marks, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        positions = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == mark]
        for left, right in zip(positions, positions[1:]):
            if right - left == 2 and row[left + 1] == background:
                out[r][left + 1] = 2
    return out
'''
